label: Half as many partial products
subgoals: Count one radix-2 partial product per multiplier bit
Group the multiplier into overlapping pairs
Halve the row count for an even-width signed multiplier

label: The recoding rule
subgoals: Append a zero below the least significant bit
Read overlapping triplets from the bottom
Map each triplet to minus two times the top bit plus the lower two bits

label: Selecting and negating multiples
subgoals: Multiply the multiplicand by each recoded digit
Shift each row left by twice its digit index
Represent negative multiples as an inversion plus a deferred one
